end.parentNote: Rohan practised comparing local and distant foods, linking longer transport with more pollution, refrigeration, packaging, cost, and reduced freshness. They first gave brief answers, then explained the definition and effects more fully during the lesson. At home, ask Rohan to compare two foods in the kitchen and identify which travelled farther and why that matters.
